message.content: In the conversation regarding Red Dead Redemption 2, Jareth shared an experience that resonated with him. Specifically, Jareth mentioned spending time helping the townsfolk, which really added depth to Arthur's character. Jareth recalled a side mission where Arthur helped a widow in the honor system, which highlighted Arthur's transformation. This side mission allowed Jareth to feel more connected to Arthur and the world around him, emphasizing the importance of helping others within the game's narrative.
